description: This file defines a function 'parse_arguments' that sets up and parses command-line options for the BORIS software project. It uses the optparse library to handle various command-line flags and options, providing functionality for debugging, version display, project specification, observation ID, and other modes.

methods.name: parse_arguments()
methods.description: Creates an OptionParser instance with specified usage and options, then parses and returns command-line arguments.
